subject: Velocify renewal evidence & stage update — Q3 renewal
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Velocify renewal evidence & stage update — Q3 renewal

Hi team,

Velocify's renewal is slated for the week of July 12 (annual, $420k ARR). Legal has signaled procurement will need PO + an up-to-date usage summary and a short list of audit artifacts (SLA uptime, last 12 months token volumes, and last quarter latency report). Finance also wants any invoice vs. usage reconciliation for Q1–Q2.

Ask: can we close out the commit status in the forecast by EOD Monday so FinOps can include the account in the Q3 revenue plan? Specifically:
- Ben: confirm stage in SFDC and whether we've moved to "Commit" vs "Verifying".
- David: can you pull the last 12 months token counts and attach the CSV (format preference: date, service, tokens_in/out)?
- Naomi: will you prepare a short reconciled invoice stub comparing our billed usage vs. actual (high-level) so procurement doesn't push back?

I'll reach out to Velocify to request the signed PO and any procurement timelines; if they can share sooner that reduces risk.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Renewal Manager, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: none in this message

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@velocifysolutions.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Harper <tom.harper@velocifysolutions.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Velocify renewal evidence & stage update — Q3 renewal

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up.

We can share a signed PO by next Wednesday at the latest. I've attached the preliminary PO (VEL-PO-2027Q3_signed.pdf) and a usage export for May to give you a sense of current consumption. Procurement will want the reconciliation doc you mentioned; happy to jump on a 15-min call if it helps.

Two quick notes:
- We had an unexpected usage spike in Feb tied to a marketing campaign; curious if that affects our billing alignment.
- Latency was called out by our infra team in early April — we had one incident but SLOs were met overall. If you need logs I can route them to your security contact.

Best,
Sara Lin
CFO, Velocify Solutions
sara.lin@velocifysolutions.com

Attachments: VEL-PO-2027Q3_signed.pdf, Velocify_usage_May2027.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Velocify renewal evidence & stage update — Q3 renewal

Priya / team — quick update from sales ops: I've moved the opportunity to "Commit - Legal Review" in SFDC and applied the 90% probability flag per our forecasting rules. I've also uploaded the PO Sara sent to the deal record (Hubspot deal/1182).

I recommend we classify the account as "Committed" in today's forecast freeze but tag it with a verification note: "PO received, awaiting reconciliation of usage spike (Feb)". That keeps the ARR in the committed column but highlights the risk to finance.

Planning a short sync tomorrow at 10:00 PT to walk through the reconciliation — invite coming.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: none

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Velocify renewal evidence & stage update — Q3 renewal

Attaching the token export and a short reconciliation table — see velocify_MAP_v2.xlsx (tab: summary). Notable points:
- Feb spike is ~38% above baseline; looks marketing-driven and aligns with Sara's note.
- Our billing window captured the spike and was invoiced; there is a $7,200 variance due to rounding/overage threshold.
- Latency incident on Apr 6 is logged; reactive mitigation applied same day and SLA shows no penalty.

I've uploaded the CSV and the MAP file to the shared drive link (included below). If procurement wants line-level CSV, we can provide it but prefer a redacted version for PII safety.

-David
David Kim
Finance Systems Analyst, Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com

Attachments: Velocify_usage_May2027.csv, velocify_MAP_v2.xlsx

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@velocifysolutions.com>, Tom Harper <tom.harper@velocifysolutions.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Velocify renewal evidence & stage update — Q3 renewal

Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround and the PO. We reviewed David's reconciliation and Ben's forecast update. Two action items before we mark the renewal closed in the revenue plan:
1) Procurement: would you confirm whether Velocify will pay the variance ($7,200) immediately or offset against future credits? If you prefer, we can issue a one-line credit note and invoice the remainder.
2) Could you share a short procurement timeline (approve-by date) — you mentioned next Wednesday for the PO; is that the approval date as well?

I'll book a 15-min sync for Wednesday morning for the reconciliation and to finalize the commit. If procurement prefers a finance-only thread, let me know and we'll move it off the deal thread.

Appreciate the partnership — Priya
